'''Fionna Flannis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as a [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Flannis was a reporter for [[Colonial News Nets]] and traveled the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], interviewing socialites, entertainment starlets and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers. She was known to produce some of the raciest stories for Colonial News Net. She was also an operative for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and would meet with Alliance agents to give them information about Rebel and Imperial activity in the Colonies. Despite working for the same organization she was not aware that [[Pertaal Shenvehr]] was also a Rebel operative.

==Personality and traits==
Flannis was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She was shrewd and would have superficial conversations until she was certain that she was speaking to an agent of the Alliance. She had blond hair and dressed in expensive and fashionable clothing. Flannis secretly felt bitter towards the upper classes and worked against the Empire so that she could embarrass the Imperial elites.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Flannis was a skilled reporter and was well versed in handling a variety of social situations. She was also talented at undercover work and was able to sneak or bluff her way past security in order to get a scoop.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Flannis dressed in the latest and most expensive fashions. She wore a matching purse that concealed her reporter's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] she kept for protection. She had access to a 100,000-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] expense account from Colonial News.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fionna Flannis was designed by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. She was illustrated by [[Mike Jackson]].
